top5.title: Tech stocks plunge after three years of gains
top5.description: The three major indexes fell sharply Friday, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 5% and wiping out all its 2026 gains. Concerns about Anthropic’s IPO, tighter regulation and inflation are driving the decline, which could also represent an overdue reset.
top5.why: The sharp technology-stock sell-off signals a potentially important market reset for AI valuations, investor confidence and the financing environment.

top5.title: CrowdStrike acquires Zscaler for $43.9 billion
top5.description: CrowdStrike has reached an all-stock agreement to acquire Zscaler in a deal valued at approximately $43.9 billion. Zscaler is expected to bring nearly 8,000 customers, while CrowdStrike anticipates roughly $1 billion in additional annual revenue.
top5.why: CrowdStrike’s proposed $43.9 billion acquisition of Zscaler would reshape cybersecurity consolidation and create a major integrated security platform.

top5.title: OpenAI calls on rival labs to limit AI training
top5.description: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki is proposing that AI labs set common limits for training advanced models. He believes safety and monitoring research could fall behind as early as 2027.
top5.why: OpenAI’s call for common limits on advanced-model training could become an important industry-led approach to AI safety, monitoring and future regulation.

top5.title: Nvidia halts shipments of Hopper chips to China
top5.description: Nvidia confirmed that no more licensed Hopper chips would be shipped to China and that these sales were disappearing from its forecasts. The decision further deepens the separation between the U.S. and Chinese AI ecosystems.
top5.why: Nvidia’s halt to licensed Hopper shipments to China deepens the technological separation between the U.S. and Chinese AI ecosystems and removes revenue from Nvidia’s forecasts.

top5.title: Discount AI API providers stole keys and read queries
top5.description: A Dragos investigation reveals that three API providers stole AWS keys and accessed their clients’ queries after a fake-query campaign. OpenRouter removed these providers and revoked the privacy label for 125 endpoints.
top5.why: The discovery that discount AI API providers stole cloud keys and accessed customer queries exposes a serious security and trust risk in the AI supply chain.
